cases.translation: they stopped by the Jordan, opposite Jericho
cases.explain: The preposition «у» (by/near) governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: A people came out of Egypt
cases.explain: The preposition «из» (out of) governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: he sent messengers for Balaam, the son of Beor
cases.explain: The preposition «за» meaning 'to fetch/for' governs the instrumental case.

cases.translation: Balaam rose in the morning and saddled the donkey
cases.explain: The transitive verb «оседлал» (saddled) takes a direct object in the accusative case.

cases.sentence: ангел Господень встал на ___, чтобы помешать ему
cases.translation: the angel of the Lord stood on the road to oppose him
cases.explain: The preposition «на» indicating location governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: стоял на дороге с обнажённым мечом в ___
cases.translation: stood on the road with a drawn sword in his hand
cases.explain: The preposition «в» indicating location governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: а он разгневался и стал бить её ___
cases.translation: and he grew angry and began to beat her with a staff
cases.explain: The instrumental case expresses the means or instrument of the action.

cases.translation: a people that covered the face of the earth
cases.explain: The genitive case expresses possession ('the face of the earth').

reading.ru: Маав очень испугался народа, потому что их было так много.
reading.question: Why was Moab afraid of the people?
reading.explain: The text says Moab was afraid because the people were so numerous.

reading.ru: Они были полны ужаса перед израилетянами.
reading.question: How did Moab feel toward the Israelites?
reading.explain: The text says they were full of terror before the Israelites.

reading.question: What did the Moabite officials do?
reading.explain: The text says the Moabite princes stayed with Balaam.

reading.ru: Бог сказал Валааму, «Не ходи с ними, не проклинай этот народ, потому что он благословен».
reading.question: What did God tell Balaam about the people?
options: They are blessed, do not curse them
reading.correct: They are blessed, do not curse them
reading.explain: God tells Balaam not to curse the people because they are blessed.

reading.ru: Валаам встал утром, оседлал ослицу и пошел с вождями Мааба.
reading.question: What animal did Balaam saddle?
reading.explain: The text says Balaam saddled his donkey and went with the princes.

reading.ru: Он низко поклонился, припав лицом к земле.
reading.question: What did Balaam do when the Lord opened his eyes?
options: He bowed low with his face to the ground
reading.correct: He bowed low with his face to the ground
reading.explain: The text says he bowed low, falling on his face to the ground.
